summary: Executed targeted follow-up verification for routed author flow, exact SKU behavior, crop drag/resize, offline rotation checks, parser memory benchmark, and PDF measurement outputs. Final combined suite ran with one remaining routed upload failure.

critical.issue: Routed multipart body arrives truncated (184 bytes; boundary-only) and returns INVALID_IMAGE 422, while direct API upload with same silver.jpg succeeds 200.

integration_issues.issue: Author flow still blocks at photo upload due routed multipart truncation; export/media usage segment cannot complete in same routed journey.

issues: Web DOM rendered_count remains 6 with FlatList virtualization; browser DOM does not hold full 40 rows simultaneously (expected virtualization behavior).

action_items: Fix routed multipart bridge so file bytes survive browser->ASGI forwarding (current post_data_buffer body is truncated).
After bridge fix, rerun test_admin_mobile_web_catalog_author_export_and_media_usage to complete export parse + media usage UI assertions.
Decide whether author upload should be covered by direct ASGI route shim alternative when browser runtime does not expose fetch/FormData body capture.
If needed, add route-level multipart raw-body capture support independent of Playwright request.post_data_buffer semantics.
critical_code_review_comments: Routed bridge currently depends on request.post_data_buffer; evidence shows multipart payload length only 184 bytes for image upload, indicating missing binary file content.
Exact SKU endpoint behavior is correct on backend for product_code=TESTMETA-09999 (total=1) while words search remains Mongo text OR tokenized (full SKU returns 10000 in 10k dataset).
Crop interaction coverage now performs real move + resize gestures and validates saved square coordinates changed.

success_rate.frontend: 80% (4/5 routed Playwright-authenticated UI tests in shared suite)

seed_data_creation: Isolated only: synthetic catalog metadata, temporary admin2 for control upload, benchmark authoring/pdf artifacts, and temporary parser outputs. No live DB mutation.
context_for_next_testing_agent: Transports remain MOCKED in isolated tests (SMS + storage + routed browser->ASGI). tsc passed (yarn tsc --noEmit). Combined suite path: /app/test_reports/pytest/iter17_shared_full_with_ui.xml (1 fail).
rca_of_issue: Repro: direct isolated API upload of silver.jpg succeeded (200), then routed Playwright author upload returned 422 INVALID_IMAGE. Captured evidence in /app/test_reports/author_upload_bridge_debug_iteration17.json shows multipart forwarded body length=184 bytes with boundary signature and no file payload; queue_count_before_pop=0 and fallback not used. This indicates the browser-route bridge (request.post_data_buffer path) is dropping/omitting real file bytes in routed mode, causing backend image verification to fail despite valid source file.
